description: Load the Claude plugin built from this checkout with --plugin-dir and run /pan-plugin-selftest headlessly; read back the verdict and whether the plugin's agents load scoped or bare.
why: Plan item 3b. The plugin's native workflow scripts spawn `pan-wizard:pan-…` because plugin agents are DOCUMENTED to load under the scoped name — but that premise was never live-measured, and the plugin's command prose still names agents bare. Probe 4 of the self-test answers both; the verdict line re-confirms placeholder expansion on the current Claude Code build. One model turn.

steps.why: The plugin under test is built fresh into the workspace, so the run measures this checkout and nothing cached.

The self-test ends with two greppable lines. `case A` = placeholder expands in command markdown (measured 2026-08-14 on 2.1.233); `AGENT_SCOPE: scoped` = the plugin's agents are namespaced as the workflow scripts assume. Either other answer is the finding, not a harness error.
